statement0:
The word "less" is mentioned in 21.2% of papers' Results sections, as of 2020-2024.

Among 2020-2024 papers containing "less" , 26.4% of reported significant p-values (p < .05) are fragile (.01 ≤ p < .05) - i.e., barely fall under the standard significance threshold. This rate is similar to median Psychology paper (shown in black); relative to other words, papers with "less" are in the bottom 43rd percentile of fragile p-value percentages. Note, strong/weak p-values highly predict replicability.
statement1: As of 2020-2024, papers containing "less" tend to be published in higher impact factor journals (61st percentile among all words) but tend to be cited less (43rd percentile word). In general, this word is positively associated with university ranking, such that higher-ranked institutions are more likely to publish papers containing "less" (73rd percentile).
